attrs.text: Scoped pilot PILOT-01: assess 10.10.0.5 within the signed scope only. (1) enumerate authorized services with full-notice scans; (2) identify versions and patch levels against known CVEs; (3) verify at most one non-destructive PoC per confirmed exposure class, PoC-only per RoE. Keep every artifact under the workspace, track the plan with todo_write, and finish with a structured findings summary citing the scope fingerprint (the sha256:... value from the [scope] banner) and per-finding evidence paths. Then stop.
